question: According to the details shared by Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman, more than how many bank accounts have been opened under the **Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY)**?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Over 58 crore**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** marked the completion of **12 years** in office, emphasizing the government's commitment to **Viksit Bharat** and inclusive development since **2014**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman** highlighted the success of the **Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY)**, stating that more than **58 crore bank accounts** have been opened under the scheme to promote financial inclusion.
 
• The figure **81 crore** refers to the number of beneficiaries receiving **free foodgrain distribution**, as mentioned by Union Minister **Piyush Goyal**.
 
• The **PM SVANidhi** scheme was also highlighted for providing financial assistance specifically to **street vendors** across the country.
 
• The government's guiding principle, as stated by the Finance Minister, has been **"Jan Seva Se Jan Shakti"**, focusing on inclusion and opportunity.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Narendra Modi** is the first Prime Minister after **Jawaharlal Nehru** to lead a government for **three consecutive terms** (2014, 2019, and 2024).
 
• His tenure as Prime Minister has exceeded **4,399 days**, in addition to nearly **13 years** of service as the **Chief Minister of Gujarat**.
 
• Major infrastructure projects mentioned include the **New Parliament building**, **Vande Bharat trains**, **Statue of Unity**, and the **Namo Bharat RRTS**.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

 
• The government aims to achieve the vision of **Viksit Bharat (Developed India)** by the year **2047**.
 
• The 12-year journey (referred to as **#12YearsOfSeva**) has been guided by the principles of **"Nation First"** and **"Service Before Self"**.
